low_power_modes_summary.suspend: Bus idle > 3 ms; device draws ≤ 500 µA from VBUS
low_power_modes_summary.selective_suspend: Host can suspend a specific downstream port; other ports continue
low_power_modes_summary.remote_wakeup: Suspended device with feature enabled drives K-state to wake bus

power_classes_of_devices: Low-power bus-powered (≤ 100 mA at all times)
High-power bus-powered (≤ 100 mA pre-config, ≤ 500 mA configured)
Self-powered (local supply; ≤ 100 mA from VBUS for enumeration)
Hub-powered (hub VBUS source feeds downstream devices)
fields.notes: USB 2.0 explicitly specifies a power budget (100/500 mA per port) + suspend behavior (500 µA). This is part of the protocol (not deferred to SoC), because the host must enforce per-port current limits and recover from over-current events.
